Quest 3 and Quest 3S Turnip driver

The bundled libvulkan_turnip_quest.so is the unmodified vulkan.ad07xx.so
from Jbbrack03/Quest-3-Turnip-Driver, package Turnip_Quest3_XEMU_2026.07b.
The APK includes this ARM64 build for 4 KiB page devices running API 29
or later. The driver uses HorizonOS-compatible KGSL allocations and handles
swapchain buffers whose gralloc layout metadata is unavailable.

Package and source provenance

Repository commit 83cd874f3449d091fca51d25389f88f520a7f2f3
https://github.com/Jbbrack03/Quest-3-Turnip-Driver/tree/83cd874f3449d091fca51d25389f88f520a7f2f3
Package Turnip_Quest3_XEMU_2026.07b.adpkg.zip
SHA-256 a4797cfa70ff4d65b4b5e43b209ebc212195bef30ba40494cb1f10e7644a278b
Member vulkan.ad07xx.so
SHA-256 096f6b3d191d385ee42f970c315189b59675b80e9d3727b6ba22008252e6aca0
GNU build ID 4ca45d3778a553925e4ccabdbf6d2b33e8a8e864

Mesa base 48297c8344669c4a867fae28e2cafb646218016e
https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/mesa/mesa/-/tree/48297c8344669c4a867fae28e2cafb646218016e
Apply the following files from the pinned Quest driver repository in order.
The repository provides the NDK r27 Android arm64 cross file and the build
instructions in HANDOFF.md. The July 17 package includes the fourth patch.

0001-android-carry-Quest-3-KGSL-compatibility-patches.patch
0002-android-remove-Eden-specific-debug-file-fallback.patch
0003-tu-support-coherent-host-memory-import-on-KGSL.patch
0004-tu-ir3-reject-corrupt-pipeline-cache-blobs.patch

Licensing

The Quest driver patches use the MIT license. Quest-Turnip-Mesa-notices.zip
contains Mesa's licensing overview, license texts and notices from its
Freedreno, Vulkan, compiler, utility and header sources at the pinned
revision. The notices identify their source files. The Android NDK runtime
terms are in NDK-toolchain-NOTICE.txt.
